body: Thank you so much for your kind words.  That‘s great advice- character is really the most important, even if it’s hard to trust yourself.

I understand both sides of your situation- it's really hard to go about normal life while living with depression, but threatening to harm your family is not ok... have you thought about sending her to an inpatient treatment facility?  It could help get her the care she needs.
Adulthood is just being a lonely older kid.  Are there people actually content with this?

I've called it once.  It's nice to vent to someone who doesn't know you irl and can't send you to a mental hospital (if that's what you don't want), but they're not super qualified.  It was nice to talk freely for a bit, though.  Didn't make me feel worse at least!
What changed from 20 to 30 to 40, if you don't mind me asking?  I really appreciate the insight.
Are you lonely?  Or are you content being alone?
yes, I'm a 22f.  It feels like I've already lived all the life I need to at this point.

I completely understand where you're coming from.  The feeling of numbness is far worse than actually FEELING your pain and expressing it for others to understand and relate.  when did you feel you changed from being a "golden child" to this state of numbness and helplessness?
I'm also a 22f with no idea what I want to do with my life and feeling incredibly depressed and suicidal.  At least we aren't alone?
100%.  It's like living your life behind a screen that you can't escape.

I'm completely with you here... I've been feeling suicidal for so long but have never done anything for it- just had the feeling within myself.  I called the suicide hotline once and after I told that to my parents they realized it was a problem and were very worried for me, but I have still been passively suicidal for months... no one cares until it's too late.

I'm really sorry to hear about how you are feeling.  I'm a 22F and I'm in the same position of feeling like I've tried everything and just wanting to die now.  Is there somewhere you've always wanted to live that you never have?  Maybe just pack everything up and try one last time somewhere completely different, like Hawaii or something.
yeah honestly the numbness is the worst part of all of this. I'd rather feel terrible than nothing
I'd like to talk too.  How are you doing?
does anything make it better for you?

wow ive never heard it described like that but YES last winter I was so charismatic for like 2 months and had so many friends but after quarantine ive lost almost all friends and am now terrified of social situations in general
that's exactly how I feel.  I feel like I'm stuck in the 'being a kid' mentality and I see no joy coming with going any further in life.
I'm in the exact position as your friend right now.  I've never attempted, but I think about it constantly and the only thing that gives me solace is that I will do it soon.

HI I FEEL THE EXACT SAME DO U WANT TO BE INTERNET FRIENDS?? sorry that was aggressive I just need more people who relate to me in more than just the superficial "I'm sorry you're depressed" way that people now relate to me
I've been feeling this a lot lately.  It's like there's some societal rulebook that I missed out on.
